title: Vanilla+ CROSSOVER
description: A compilation of Create and QOL to give a unique divergent Minecraft experience.
body:
# Attempting to expand minecraft while keeping it feeling Vanilla

Includes
- Create and a few mods to enhance the create experience
- Three mods to backport newer minecraft features such as the copper age and happy ghasts
- Iris Shaders to allow you to customise your minecraft visuals
- Emotecraft and Customizable player models to let you express yourself better
- Sodium to help the game run smoother
- Inventory Essentials to sort your inventories
- and Waystones to help you find your way around the world
